products.description:
Rack & Stackis one of the most trusted and leading manufacturers and suppliers of Heavy Duty Slotted Angle Racks in India. With over 30 years of experience in storage and racking systems, we bring durable, cost-effective, and space-saving storage solutions designed to meet the needs of industrial, commercial, and institutional environments.

Our Heavy Duty Slotted Angle Racks are strong, flexible, and highly customisable storage systems that allow efficient organisation of goods, materials, and supplies. These racks are made from high-grade mild steel and are perfect for storing medium to heavy-load items in warehouses, factories, offices, and godowns.

Engineered with slotted angles and strong shelves, these racks provide the benefit of adjustability, allowing users to modify shelf height and configuration based on changing requirements. The modular design ensures ease of assembly, dismantling, relocation, and scalability.
products.longDescription:
The slotted angle rack system consists of vertical angle posts with uniformly spaced perforations (slots) along their length. These slots allow the user to fix steel shelves at desired heights using nuts and bolts.

The structure is assembled manually using hand tools, making it quick and easy to install.
Each shelf can support substantial weight, depending on its thickness and reinforcement.
The modularity of the design allows users to add or remove shelves, increase rack height, or even expand the rack horizontally without structural changes.
Heavy duty slotted angle racks work best for manual storage, picking, and reorganising of materials without the need for forklifts or automated systems.

products.name: Slotted Angle Racks
products.shortDescription: We offer a premium range of Heavy Duty Slotted Angle Racks designed for safe, efficient, and space-saving usage across various industrial applications.
products.description:
Rack & Stackis one of the most trusted and leading manufacturers and suppliers of Heavy Duty Slotted Angle Racks in India. With over 30 years of experience in storage and racking systems, we bring durable, cost-effective, and space-saving storage solutions designed to meet the needs of industrial, commercial, and institutional environments.

Our Heavy Duty Slotted Angle Racks are strong, flexible, and highly customisable storage systems that allow efficient organisation of goods, materials, and supplies. These racks are made from high-grade mild steel and are perfect for storing medium to heavy-load items in warehouses, factories, offices, and godowns.

Engineered with slotted angles and strong shelves, these racks provide the benefit of adjustability, allowing users to modify shelf height and configuration based on changing requirements. The modular design ensures ease of assembly, dismantling, relocation, and scalability.
products.longDescription:
The slotted angle rack system consists of vertical angle posts with uniformly spaced perforations (slots) along their length. These slots allow the user to fix steel shelves at desired heights using nuts and bolts.

The structure is assembled manually using hand tools, making it quick and easy to install.
Each shelf can support substantial weight, depending on its thickness and reinforcement.
The modularity of the design allows users to add or remove shelves, increase rack height, or even expand the rack horizontally without structural changes.
Heavy duty slotted angle racks work best for manual storage, picking, and reorganising of materials without the need for forklifts or automated systems.

products.shortDescription: We offer a premium range of Heavy Duty Slotted Angle Racks designed for safe, efficient, and space-saving usage across various industrial applications.
products.description:
Rack & Stackis one of the most trusted and leading manufacturers and suppliers of Heavy Duty Slotted Angle Racks in India. With over 30 years of experience in storage and racking systems, we bring durable, cost-effective, and space-saving storage solutions designed to meet the needs of industrial, commercial, and institutional environments.

Our Heavy Duty Slotted Angle Racks are strong, flexible, and highly customisable storage systems that allow efficient organisation of goods, materials, and supplies. These racks are made from high-grade mild steel and are perfect for storing medium to heavy-load items in warehouses, factories, offices, and godowns.

Engineered with slotted angles and strong shelves, these racks provide the benefit of adjustability, allowing users to modify shelf height and configuration based on changing requirements. The modular design ensures ease of assembly, dismantling, relocation, and scalability.
products.longDescription:
The slotted angle rack system consists of vertical angle posts with uniformly spaced perforations (slots) along their length. These slots allow the user to fix steel shelves at desired heights using nuts and bolts.

The structure is assembled manually using hand tools, making it quick and easy to install.
Each shelf can support substantial weight, depending on its thickness and reinforcement.
The modularity of the design allows users to add or remove shelves, increase rack height, or even expand the rack horizontally without structural changes.
Heavy duty slotted angle racks work best for manual storage, picking, and reorganising of materials without the need for forklifts or automated systems.
